text: The Mosfell church has always played an important role in the cultural life of the town of Mosfellsbær. Various events that cannot be classified as religious ceremonies take place there, and the most interesting of these are the annual advent concerts that have been held since the year 1997. From the beginning, the concerts have had premiers of rewritten classical music with an unusual combination of music and vocals. For many inhabitants of the Mosfell Valley this concert is part of their essential preparation for Christmas.
